test_title: PYST 36: SSC GD Constable 2025 - English (Held On: 20 Feb, 2025 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is '**on**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase “based on” is the correct prepositional combination in English usage.
 
• It correctly connects the concept of education being founded or grounded upon climate science.
 
• "**On**" is the only option that forms a standard and idiomatic phrase with “based.”
 
• Other options (“at”, “in”, “by”) do not form the correct phrase and would make the sentence grammatically incorrect.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

 

Complete Passage: *Given the amount of 1. denial__ and misunderstanding surrounding the climate crisis, 2. __wholehearted__ climate education and engagement are fundamental to addressing the root causes of climate change. We need education not only based 3. __on__ climate science but also on the ways in 4. __which__ climate change is deeply intertwined with a range of other social, racial and environmental issues that 5. __shape__ our daily life experiences.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• At: “Based at” is not a standard phrase for this context.
 
• In: “Based in” is used for locations, not subject matter.
 
• By: “Based by” is not grammatically correct in this structure.
